meta.title: Tower
meta.description: Mission planning, isolated worktrees, worker/reviewer agents, and review-gated merges.

tower-bundle.title: Tower
tower-bundle.summary: Mission planning, isolated worktrees, worker/reviewer agents, and merge gates.
tower-bundle.disables: Turns off the whole Tower bundle; no orphan preset or skill is left behind.

tower-skills.title: Tower skills
tower-skills.summary: Playbooks for worker/reviewer agents and recovery after a blocked merge.
tower-skills.disables: Internal section; toggled with the Tower bundle.

preset-tower-worker.title: Tower worker
preset-tower-worker.summary: Writes code, runs verification, and commits only the files assigned to its mission.
preset-tower-worker.disables: Internal section; a missing preset is rejected before planning/mode entry.

preset-tower-reviewer.title: Tower reviewer
preset-tower-reviewer.summary: Read-only checks for scope and acceptance, returning a clean verdict or findings.
preset-tower-reviewer.disables: Internal section; a missing preset is rejected before planning/mode entry when review is required.
